sn14.24:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || Dhātuso bhikkhave sattā saṃsandanti samenti || || Asaddhā asaddhehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || ahirikā ahirikehi saddhiṃ- || anottāpino anottāpīhi saddhiṃ- || dussīlā dussīlehi saddhiṃ- || duppaññā duppaññehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || ||
sn14.24:2.1: Saddhā saddhehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || hirimanā hirimanehi saddhiṃ- || ottāpino ottāpīhi saddhimo || sīlavanto sīlavantehi saddhiṃ- || paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samentīti || || Dutiyaṃ || ||
